name: odere-pro
description: odere-pro's Claude Code plugins — a single marketplace that aggregates each plugin from its own repository, so every plugin installs individually as <plugin>@odere-pro.

plugins.name: claude-oop-excellence
plugins.description: Language-agnostic OOP design enforcement. A single read-only /audit front door runs two tracks in parallel — RISK (issues) and PATTERN (existing-pattern scan + pattern-fit suggestions) — into one unified report; every track / aspect / family / entity is individually selectable. Driven by a canonical glossary of 102 entities (45 issues + 57 design patterns), with glossary-driven workers fanning out per family in parallel and an audit → action handoff to gated, test-verified fix and implement commands.

plugins.name: claude-calibration
plugins.description: Audit and harden a Claude Code setup: an evaluate → plan → calibrate → re-evaluate loop over CLAUDE.md, rules, settings, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, and plugins, where recurring findings are promoted into enforcement (hooks/rules/wrapper skills).
